import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import codecs
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, chi2
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Standardize column names
for df in [train_df, test_df, sample_sub]:
    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()

# Handle missing values
train_df["Comment"].fillna("", inplace=True)
test_df["Comment"].fillna("", inplace=True)


def clean_text(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    if len(text) > 1 and (
        (text[0] == '"' and text[-1] == '"') or (text[0] == "'" and text[-1] == "'")
    ):
        text = text[1:-1]
    try:
        text = codecs.decode(text, "unicode_escape")
    except Exception:
        pass
    return text


train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

X_train_full = train_df["Comment"]
y_train_full = train_df["Insult"]

# Hold-out validation split (stratified to preserve class distribution)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Word-level TF-IDF: trigrams with sublinear TF scaling
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"])

# Character-level TF-IDF: character words n-grams with sublinear TF scaling
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3, 5), min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment"])

# Combine word and character features into a single sparse matrix
X_train_vec = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_vec = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test_vec = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Feature selection: retain top 10,000 statistically discriminative features
selector = SelectKBest(chi2, k=10000)
X_train_selected = selector.fit_transform(X_train_vec, y_train)
X_val_selected = selector.transform(X_val_vec)
X_test_selected = selector.transform(X_test_vec)

# Ensemble setup
val_probs_ensemble = np.zeros(len(y_val))
test_probs_ensemble = np.zeros(len(test_df))
n_models = 5
seeds = [42, 123, 456, 789, 1024]

print(f"Training ensemble of {n_models} LogisticRegression models...")
for seed in seeds:
    clf = LogisticRegression(
        solver="liblinear",
        class_weight="balanced",
        max_iter=1000,
        warm_start=False,
        random_state=seed,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train_selected, y_train)

    # Accumulate averaged probabilities
    val_probs_ensemble += clf.predict_proba(X_val_selected)[:, 1] / n_models
    test_probs_ensemble += clf.predict_proba(X_test_selected)[:, 1] / n_models

# Evaluate ensemble on hold-out validation set (strictly separated from training)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs_ensemble)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on the unlabeled test set
test_probs = test_probs_ensemble

# Format and save submission
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission.iloc[:, 0] = test_probs
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission successfully saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
